summary: Completed final P0 backend+frontend retest for template defaulting, sanitized preview, output buttons, and WhatsApp flow gating. Backend contracts passed, and most UI acceptance points passed; one critical QuickPrint WhatsApp integration issue remains.

ui_bugs.issue: WhatsApp flow still blocks with phone-required/error even after entering valid phone in quick-print-phone-input; wa.me/share-sheet not reached.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend passes phone to prepareShare, but resolve-message still runs with payload customer phone empty; captured response returned phone.valid=false and missing_variables=['PLATE_NO'], so no navigator.share/wa.me open.

issues: Uploaded malicious becomes broken image request (/x → 500), causing noisy console errors though sanitization itself works

action_items: Fix QuickPrint WhatsApp integration to include phone/vehicle fallback in payload before resolveOutboundMessage call (or override resolve input with entered phone).
Ensure QuickPrint WhatsApp path reaches navigator.share or wa.me when phone is entered and template is valid.
Optional hardening: normalize broken relative image src values in sanitized preview to avoid /x 500 noise.
critical_code_review_comments: QuickPrint uses phoneCandidate for local validation, but useWhatsAppShare.prepare resolves outbound message from payload customer phone; this contract mismatch causes false blocking despite valid input.
P0 requested output controls are correct now: QuickPrint/DocumentPrint expose only WhatsApp/PDF/Print with no secondary WhatsApp preview modal in this flow.
Large frontend modules remain (e.g., DocumentPrint.jsx and OperationCard.jsx >700 lines), increasing regression risk for P0-sensitive flows.

success_rate.frontend: 83% (5/6 requested acceptance points pass; QuickPrint WhatsApp valid-phone route fails)

seed_data_creation: Created UI templates: ITER288_SAFE_UI and ITER288_BROKEN_UI for this retest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: [[CUSTOMER_NAME]] replacement works in sanitized template-preview-frame; quick-print-error deterministic Arabic missing-variable list works for broken template; set-default showed one active invoice card in tested state; DocumentPrint has exactly three output buttons and no duplicate output toolbar buttons. Remaining blocker is QuickPrint WhatsApp valid-phone routing not reaching wa.me/share.
rca of the issue: RCA: In QuickPrint, entered phone is validated locally (phoneCandidate) but outbound resolve-message uses payload.customer.phone from prepareShare payload, which can remain empty. Backend then returns phone.valid=false and missing_variables (observed: PLATE_NO), so prepare fails and route never opens navigator.share/wa.me. Mitigation: merge entered phone and vehicle fallbacks into resolve payload before calling /api/outbound/resolve-message.
